# Moonphase Hair

Moonphase Hair is a free web app for cutting hair according to the lunar cycle.

REST API: /api
MCP: /mcp
Docs: /developers
Markdown: send Accept: text/markdown or Accept: application/markdown

## Access

The public API and MCP server are free. No API key or OAuth is required.
CORS is enabled for browser clients.

## REST

GET /api
GET /api?date=2026-09-08

Returns the moon phase, illumination, timing, and hair-cutting advice.
Dates accept ISO-8601, YYYY-MM-DD, or Unix timestamps.

## Website as Markdown

Public pages (`/`, `/developers`, `/full-moon-fasting`, `/privacy`) return
Markdown when the request includes:

- Accept: text/markdown
- Accept: application/markdown

## MCP

Separate Streamable HTTP server at /mcp.

Tools:

- get_current_moon_phase
- get_moon_phase
- list_hair_guides
- get_next_moon_phase
- get_full_moon_fasting

Cursor example:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "moonphase-hair": {
      "url": "https://<your-domain>/mcp"
    }
  }
}
